properties.displayName: UAV S2 - Parameter Tampering (ARMING_CHECK/Safety Config Bypass)
properties.description: UAV 안전 파라미터 변조 탐지. 공격자가 MAVLink PARAM_SET으로 ARMING_CHECK/BRD_SAFETYENABLE/SIM_GPS_* 등 비행통제 컨트롤러 태스킹·안전설정 파라미터를 변경해 이륙전 안전점검을 무력화하거나 GNSS 스푸핑 사전조건을 조성하는 행위 탐지. UAVConfigAudit_CL의 param_changed 이벤트 기준. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0821·T0836 / EMB3D 파라미터변조
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 1h;
let DangerousParams = dynamic(['ARMING_CHECK','FS_GCS_ENABL','FS_THR_ENABLE','FS_BATT_ENABLE','BRD_SAFETYENABLE','SIM_GPS_DISABLE','SIM_GPS_GLITCH_X','SIM_GPS_GLITCH_Y','SIM_GPS_GLITCH_Z']);
UAVConfigAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventType == 'param_changed'
| where ParamId in (DangerousParams)
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    ParamId == 'ARMING_CHECK' and ParamValueAfter == 0, '이륙전_안전점검_비활성화',
    ParamId startswith 'FS_' and ParamValueAfter == 0, 'Failsafe_비활성화',
    ParamId == 'BRD_SAFETYENABLE' and ParamValueAfter == 0, '하드웨어_안전스위치_비활성화',
    ParamId startswith 'SIM_GPS_', 'GNSS_스푸핑_사전조건_파라미터_변경',
    '위험_파라미터_변경'
)
| extend DetectionDetail = strcat('ParamId:', ParamId, '|Before:', ParamValueBefore, '|After:', ParamValueAfter, '|Source:', Source)
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TriggerReason, DetectionDetail, ParamId, ParamValueBefore, ParamValueAfter, Source
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S2 - Parameter Tampering (ARMING_CHECK/Safety Config Bypass) - {{UAVId}}
